mapper.select: select template_id, owner_user_id, template_code, template_name, summary, mood, score, conclusion, mistake, next_plan, sort, del_flag, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, remark, case when owner_user_id = 0 then 1 else 0 end as system_template from stock_review_template where del_flag = '0' and (owner_user_id = 0 or owner_user_id = #{ownerUserId}) order by owner_user_id asc, sort asc, template_id asc

select template_id, owner_user_id, template_code, template_name, summary, mood, score, conclusion, mistake, next_plan, sort, del_flag, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, remark, case when owner_user_id = 0 then 1 else 0 end as system_template from stock_review_template where template_id = #{templateId} and del_flag = '0' and (owner_user_id = 0 or owner_user_id = #{ownerUserId})
mapper.update: update stock_review_template set del_flag = '2', update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = sysdate() where template_id = #{templateId} and owner_user_id = #{ownerUserId} and owner_user_id != 0 and del_flag = '0'
